rules.name: Business Logic — Price Manipulation
rules.description: Detects price manipulation attempts via negative quantities, zero-price items, or modified totals in checkout
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg10_001", "action" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'VcnFlowLogs' AND "action" = 'REJECT' AND "srcaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "dstaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "value" > 0

rules.name: Business Logic — Rate Limit Bypass
rules.description: Detects API rate limit bypass attempts using header manipulation, IP rotation, or parameter tampering
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg10_002", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%business%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%logic%') AND "value" > 0

rules.name: Business Logic — Workflow Bypass
rules.description: Detects attempts to skip workflow steps or access later stages without completing prerequisites
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg10_003", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%business%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%logic%') AND "value" > 0

rules.name: Business Logic — Negative Quantity or Amount
rules.description: Detects transactions with negative quantities or amounts indicating business logic bypass
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg10_004", "action" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'VcnFlowLogs' AND "action" = 'REJECT' AND "srcaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "dstaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "value" > 0

rules.name: Error Handling — Verbose Error Information Disclosure
rules.description: Detects verbose error responses containing stack traces, database details, or internal paths
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg10_005", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%error%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%handling%') AND "value" > 0

rules.name: Cryptography — Weak Hash Algorithm Usage
rules.description: Detects usage of weak hash algorithms (MD5, SHA1) in application transactions or certificate signatures
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg10_006", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%cryptography%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%weak%') AND "value" > 0

rules.name: Data Classification — PII in Logs
rules.description: Detects PII data (SSN, credit card, email) appearing in application logs in cleartext
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg10_007", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%data%' AND "value" > 0

rules.name: Data Classification — Unencrypted Data at Rest
rules.description: Detects storage of sensitive data without encryption at rest in databases, file systems, or object stores
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg10_008", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%data%' AND "value" > 0
